headings.text: Domestic appliances have nearly a hundred history and help people with trivial and time consuming housework, creating a more comfortable and beautiful life environment for human beings. Many domestic appliances such as washing machines, bushing, bolts, screws and shafts are made by CNC machining. Automatic lathing can manufacture parts with good precision. Usually, parts with small length are manufactured by using automatic lathing if the quantity is big. For parts with big length such as enclosures and cases, we can use CNC machining . Junying has rich experience in home appliances parts manufacturing.
